page_title: LEN 1-0 HAV | Lens v Le Havre 30/01/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+13' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+11' The fouls committed statistics – 18:10.
90+8' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Kyllian Antonio (Lens) was quite harsh and Jeremy Stinat didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.

90+7' Fine play by Mamadou Sangare (Lens) opens up space on the edge of the box for the shot, but his effort lacks accuracy and flies miles past the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Le Havre.
90+5' Here's the change. Florian Thauvin leaves the pitch and Florian Sotoca (Lens) comes on as a substitute.
90+5' Pierre Sage prepares a substitution. Wesley Said is replaced by Abdallah Sima (Lens).
90+5' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Lens.
90+4' Stephan Zagadou just cannot continue due to injury and has to be substituted. Felix Mambimbi (Le Havre) replaces him.

90+3' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Wesley Said (Lens). The ball goes behind for a corner. Lens will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
90+3' Lens hold the ball and display nice passing from player to player.
90+3' Substitution. Simon Ebonog leaves the pitch and is replaced by Kenny Quetant (Le Havre).
90+2' Florian Thauvin (Lens) plays a through ball inside the box, but it's too strong and Lionel Mpasi-Nzau comes off his line to intercept.
90' 12 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' Stephan Zagadou (Le Havre) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
88' Stephan Zagadou (Le Havre) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
87' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Le Havre comes to nothing.
87' Issa Soumare (Le Havre) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. The linesman makes the right call and Le Havre will have a corner.
86' The free kick from close range, taken by Le Havre, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
86' Adrien Thomasson (Lens) brings an opponent down and Jeremy Stinat interrupts the game. Le Havre have a free kick.
85' Le Havre are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
83' The current number of fouls conceded by both teams is 15:9.
80' Ayumu Seko (Le Havre) picks up an injury.
78' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Fode Doucoure (Le Havre) will replace Loic Nego.
78' Lucas Gourna-Douath (Le Havre) has tested the patience of referee Jeremy Stinat and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
76' Referee Jeremy Stinat sees the trip by Adrien Thomasson (Lens) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle. Le Havre will take a free kick.
75' Here is a change. Odsonne Edouard is going off and Pierre Sage gives the last tactical orders to Rayan Fofana (Lens).
74' Rassoul Ndiaye (Le Havre) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.
73' The resulting corner from Rassoul Ndiaye (Le Havre) is cleared by the opposition's defence. The ball goes out for a corner. Le Havre can continue in their attacking effort.
70' Didier Digard decides to make a substitution. Yanis Zouaoui will be replaced by Timothee Pembele (Le Havre).
69' The manager makes a subsitution with Noam Obougou (Le Havre) coming on for Sofiane Boufal.
69' Celebrations are cut short for Lens as the referee indicates NO GOAL after the VAR review shows it was handball!
68' Wait! Referee Jeremy Stinat has indicated he is going to review the Lens goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was a handball in the build-up.
66' Goal! Adrien Thomasson (Lens) fires the rebound into the bottom left corner after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 2:0.
65' The shots on goal statistics – 3:2.
62' A pass into the box finds Issa Soumare (Le Havre) unmarked. He carefully places a shot towards the right side of the goal, but a brilliant last-ditch save by Robin Risser denies him.
59' Didier Digard is forced to make a change. Arouna Sangante is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Daren Nbenbege Mosengo (Le Havre).
58' Arouna Sangante (Le Havre) wants to continue but the body doesn’t look willing!
55' Arouna Sangante (Le Havre) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.

55' Arouna Sangante (Le Havre) leaps highest in the penalty area to get on the end of a cross from the set piece, and he produces a promising goal-bound header to the bottom left corner, but Robin Risser pulls off a decent save to deny him.
54' Sofiane Boufal (Le Havre) takes the ball and sets it for the free kick.
54' Mamadou Sangare (Lens) makes a slide tackle, but referee Jeremy Stinat blows for a foul. Le Havre earn a free kick.
53' Rough tackle by Ismaelo Ganiou (Lens). The referee blows his whistle for a foul. Le Havre win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.

51' The cross into the penalty area from Wesley Said (Lens) needed to be more accurate in order to create a goal-scoring opportunity for his team. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Le Havre.
50' Lens take the free kick with a short pass.
49' Sofiane Boufal (Le Havre) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Jeremy Stinat had an easy-decision to make.
48' Neat passing move from Le Havre in order to create new attacking opportunities.
46' The second half has just started.
45+3' Jeremy Stinat has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.

45+1' 1 - 0 It's a goal! Ruben Aguilar (Lens) shows off his superb ability as he volleys the ball from inside the box into the right side of the target. The assist goes to Matthieu Udol and the score changes to 1:0.
45' The fourth official shows 1 min. of added time.
45' Mamadou Sangare (Lens) strikes from the edge of the box, but hits it really poorly and sends the ball way wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Le Havre.
42' Florian Thauvin (Lens) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Le Havre.
41' Ruben Aguilar (Lens) tries to create a chance, but puts too much weight on his pass.
38' Mamadou Sangare (Lens) knocks his opponent down with an over-the-top tackle. Le Havre have been awarded a free kick.

36' Adrien Thomasson plays a lovely pass into Matthieu Udol (Lens), but he can't find the target. His strike from inside the box goes narrowly wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Le Havre.
34' The number of shots on goal at present is 2:0.
31' Adrien Thomasson (Lens) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear.

31' Malang Sarr (Lens) gets into a good scoring position. He creates some space for himself and tries his luck from distance. His decent effort towards the bottom right corner is, however, superbly saved by Lionel Mpasi-Nzau! The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Lens.
30' Lens are showing great team chemistry. They are passing the ball around seamlessly.

28' Issa Soumare (Le Havre) starts an individual run, not looking to pass to a teammate, and easily weaves through the defence to get deep inside the box. He shoots low, but misses the goal by a whisker! The ball goes out of play and Lens will have a goal kick.
26' Adrien Thomasson (Lens) puts a cross into the box from the free kick, but the defender gets there first. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Le Havre.
26' Ayumu Seko (Le Havre) commits a rough challenge and Jeremy Stinat blows his whistle for a foul. A free kick is awarded to Lens.
22' Some neat passing and movement from Le Havre as they ping around some short passes in order to create a new attacking opportunity.
20' The corner from Florian Thauvin (Lens) is cleared away by the defence.

20' Florian Thauvin (Lens) strikes the ball towards the top left corner of the goal from inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders steps in and blocks the effort with a header. The linesman points to the corner flag, Lens are going to take it.
19' A lofted pass into the box is met by Florian Thauvin (Lens), who rifles a shot just wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Le Havre will have a goal kick.
18' 62:38 – the latest ball possession ratio.
16' Matthieu Udol (Lens) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
15' Ruben Aguilar (Lens) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Jeremy Stinat signals. A free kick has been awarded to Le Havre.
13' Lens failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
13' A cross from Ruben Aguilar (Lens) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety. The ball goes out of play. Lens are awarded a corner kick.
12' A loose ball is pounced on by Florian Thauvin (Lens) inside the box. He immediately fires in a shot towards the bottom left corner, but Lionel Mpasi-Nzau is alert and makes a comfortable save.
11' Loic Nego (Le Havre) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
11' Issa Soumare (Le Havre) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Robin Risser intercepts the ball.
9' Mamadou Sangare (Lens) wastes a golden opportunity inside the box by shooting straight into the back of an opponent when the goal was at his mercy.
7' Some great controlled play and passing from Le Havre. They are increasing their possession of the ball and trying to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
5' Sofiane Boufal (Le Havre) plays a through ball but overhits it.
4' Great teamplay by Lens as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
2' Sofiane Boufal (Le Havre) takes the free kick but it is cleared by the first defender.
2' There is a free kick near the sideline to Le Havre.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are on the pitch and Lens will have the kick-off.
Jeremy Stinat will officiate today.
